title: DevSweepRule
description: Rule specification for detecting, guarding and cleaning AI & developer tools (Schema v1.1)

homepage.description: Official project website or repository URL

protection.description: Active survival checks to prevent cleaning running software

process_names.description: Process names to check in the system process table (via pgrep)

lock_files.description: Lock file paths indicating active runtime (e.g., SingletonLock)

detection.description: Signals to determine if the software is actively installed

caches.description: Temporary cache files or silent offline updater packages safe to delete

preferences.description: Window state, plists, and UI settings

credentials.description: OAuth tokens, refresh tokens, active credentials, API keys

ai_models.description: Local embedding models, vector weights, LLMs (e.g., BGE-M3, GGUF blobs)

data_and_history.description: Session databases, chat logs, persistent runtime data

binaries_and_scripts.description: Installed CLI scripts and executable wrappers

protect_git_repos.description: Block deletion if target contains a .git repository

protect_workspaces.description: Block deletion if target contains code workspaces (.svn, .obsidian)

exclude_paths.description: Explicit paths strictly protected from cleanup

path.description: Target path, supporting ~ and glob wildcards

description.description: Human-readable description of what this target stores

default_selected.description: Whether this item is pre-selected for cleanup in interactive mode

contains_secrets.description: Flags whether this path stores credentials, tokens, or private secrets

is_model_weight.description: Flags whether this path contains local LLM weights or vector embedding models
